1-2#2.text: Sorry if I woke you up! I was just going through some of the latest photos I shot in Bovisa…

1-2#8.text: I’m so sorry, I woke you up again… It’s so different here from my home, I just have to get used to it!

1-2#13.text: It really is! I applied here to make my interests useful and… meaningful, but even though I’ve only been here a couple of days, I can’t breathe! Maybe I've made a mistake, you know, I am a free spirit after all...

1-2#15.text: Wait, wait, wait! Am I high or is there a shadow over the window? It looks like someone trying to escape... doesn’t it? I’m so fucking curious, let’s find out what’s going on! Are you with me?

1-2#17.text: That’s ok… we can try to follow it. Looks like it’s headed for the first-floor staircase of B2. But keep calm, we have to be really cautious!

1-2#18.text: No, no... are you crazy? Following it is too dangerous! But if I’m not wrong, there are some classrooms near the main entrance of the B2 building. I suppose it’ll pass by there when it comes back. We can try to wait for it there…

1-2#01.text:
I wish you all a wonderful academic year, my dear students!
First, I’m glad to announce that this year there will be no changes in the faculty. We can reconfirm all the excellence in teaching that makes our University one of the best schools in the country.

1-2#02.text:
I’m also glad to introduce Yda to you! She’s our student representative and she will play a major role here: she will connect all of you with the teachers.
I have to remind you, anyway, that in order to prevent intrusions from outside, our campus has a security service at all hours, and it is reinforced at night.

1-2#03.text:
Remember that these people don’t know who you are, so they won’t make any distinction between you and outsiders.
I invite you all to respect the curfew and not to walk around the university at night without written permission; besides, I also strongly advise you not to even try to escape from the campus at any time of the day.

1-2#04.text: As happens every year, today I’m introducing to you this year’s “worthy” one, who has entered the University system from the suburbs thanks to his school results and his strong desire to receive the best education in the country, in order to have the chance of a bright future.

1-2#05.text: I ask you all to make him feel welcome and to help him become part of the University and of our student groups, making him feel the importance of this place and the beauty of our school and educational program.

1-2#06.text:
In conclusion, I wish you all the best possible year, one that can enrich your education along a path of growth and maturity, according to the meticulous and exemplary regulations of the University.
But now, it’s time to go to your classrooms! Let’s go, everyone!

Well, once, while he was doing this mural, he took a coaster from this brewery, peeled off the top layer, drew a piece of this mural on it and then asked Guido to figure out where it would fit... I mean, you get it? They get along because they are both crazy as fuck!

23#5.text: It ended with Guido all stoned, and it took him so long that in the end 2501 took pity on him and drew an arrow pointing to the spot to help him, and then he bought him a beer! In the end I kept that coaster, because it was really a trip! Try it yourself, come on!

24-2#2.text: Weren't we supposed to say something once we got here? I forgot already

24-2#14.text: Hey yo Gabri! What's up? This is Petronio, my mate from university.

24-2#15.text: Nice to meet you, Gabriele! Sirio is taking me on some hidden tours of the suburbs. Unfortunately, after the reform, my father never allowed me...

24-2#16.text: I hear you... and this damn reform doesn't help at all, does it? Oh, I almost forgot! I have just finished brewing a new beer with the ingredients I brought back from my last trip to Germany, I called it Kayser Soze. Would you like some?

24-2#23.text: Dude, you know, Gabriele doesn't like jerks and people who peel his coasters, like 2501, so he found a way to tell them...

24-2#30.text: Yes, I'd say it fits us perfectly! We're so late, we have to go back to University.

24-2#31.text: Time flies out here! Come on, hurry up, but let's go through the B1 door, which is the only faulty one. See you soon, Gabriele!
24-2#31.instruction: Enter the university through the B1 door

24#4.text: Actually I didn't understand much, he was very vague and when I asked for more he immediately changed the subject, so we'll have to be very convincing.

24#13.text: Hi kids! You arrived just in time, I just finished preparing a new drink I learned to make in Thailand. Would you like to taste it? So you can also give me your opinion...

24#15.text: Eh, small talk is not my favorite thing.

24#16.text: Gabri, to be honest, we are here because we have to talk to you about the principal, and I remember you let slip something about her, as if you knew her

24#17.text: You know, your help could be crucial. We would love to create a new university system with more freedom and fewer rules... We have already thought of everything.

24#18.text: You two enjoy being a pain in my ass, huh? Your intentions are really noble, but I imagine you know that they alone are never enough, especially when it comes to changing something.

24#21.text: Yes, kid, we were very close as children, even if very different. Then she became a great bitch, a person hungry for power, willing to do anything for it, including ruining our relationship by plotting behind everyone's back and lying shamelessly.

24#23.text: When the reform took place it seemed to suit everyone inside the fucking system, and as far as I was concerned those weren't my fucking problems anyway. But now that you want to change things, why should I keep quiet? Now you know everything there is to know.

24#25.text: These names tell me nothing. You can do some more research if you think your principal is hiding something, but be careful, you're playing with fire.

24#26.text: All right Gabri, we'll be back, you'll see. Come on Petronio, it's time to go back, we'll find out more next time! Now let's go back to University and go to B2.2.14, to see if Yda is there as usual.

24#180.text: We did some research and found these 3 names. By any chance, do they tell you anything about the principal?
24#180.instruction: Write the names with the right capital letters

24#fin1.text: Look Petronio! The news is in the newspaper! The headmistress got arrested and now the University will be a completely different place.

25#2.text: As it turns out, you are idiots, and... oops, with the evidence I gathered you got someone's attention: the principal wants to see you.

25#3.text: Here they are, our rebels. I didn't expect it from someone like you, Petronio; as for Sirio, I didn't have much hope, seeing where he grew up. Did you really think you could fool me?

25#4.text: Nobody has ever succeeded in all these years, Minerva, I don't see how they could be the first. By the way, Sirio, I really congratulate you on wasting a unique opportunity

25#11.text: Thank you Roberto, as always you took the words right out of my mouth. It's people like you and Yda, who understand all the benefits the reform has brought to the University, who count and will count in the future.

25#13.text: Exactly: you are expelled from the University forever, with no possibility of appeal.

25#15.text: I've never been so pissed off, I really didn't expect such a scene from Roberto; from that chick Yda, yes, but from Roberto...

26#2.text: Look, I still have two photos from when they were doing these pieces... Take them! For your collection ahah

27#2.text: Isn't that it on the counter near the cash desk? That ban notice with your face on it hahaha.

27#3.text: There it is hahaha. Anyway, look, I'm not a fool! My grandpa's shop was here on this street and if he'd seen it he would have killed me, that's why I sneaked back to scratch it out!

27#5.text: Take it easy man! Try to complete the writing, somewhere I still have a transparent sheet to help you...

27#12.text: Come on, move your ass, I'll show you where I became who I am.

28#4.text: Eh, tell me about it. Now that I've been away for a while, I hardly recognize it anymore.

28#11.text: Come on, enough with this sentimental shit! It just occurred to me that nearby, in Via Guerzoni 39, there's Su's new shop, I haven't been there yet, let's go say hello.

29#1.text: Hi Sirio, you finally managed to come! You've been promising for months and you never came, you're always the same! I see your friend is here too.

29#2.text: Finally, huh? You know it's a bad time to hang around freely... yo anyway, this new stuff here is lit! Look Petronio!

29#4.text: Okay guys, to make me and my art more understandable, try making the origami: you could learn something unexpected, something it's better for you to remember.

29#5.text: I'll take you to another small park now, the one in Via Livigno 5! When we get there, remind me that I have to tell you about HOPSCOTCH!

29#7.text: We were waiting for you... we saw you last night as well. Unfortunately Yda caught us. I... I'm dying to see that world outside! Sirio told me about it... he really misses his freedom!

29#41a.text: I certainly don't get it, but I can appreciate it, just like a lot of the stuff Sirio is showing me around here in Bovisa.

29#41b.text: Eh, maybe that's just how it is... As an outsider, your jewels don't say much to me...

29#31a.text: Good evening professor! We saw you climb over the University gate, twice... We are curious: where do you run away to when you go out?

29#399a.text: Wow, congratulations Su! I love them. I'd love to learn to make things by hand myself, like you all do here in the suburbs!

29#399b.text: Ehm... Let's say they remind me a little of those surprises you used to find in snacks as a kid...

29#21a.text: Come on, I was kidding! I'm starting to act like Sirio hahaha You are very good, frankly, I'm the one who has trouble understanding art, considering where I grew up...

30#4.text: I don't know, let's get closer!

30#11.text: You're right, but we are geniuses! Come on, solve it!

30#13.text: Well, it just says "Turn", but turn where?

30#14.text: Have you tried 180°? And I'm supposed to be the dumb one! Anyway look, that's the Fernet Branca chimney over there. It just occurred to me that we could drop by: it's in Via Resegone 2, and inside there's the "Collezione Branca".

31#3.text: Can we go in and visit?

31#4.text: Sure, it's not just there for looks ahahahaha, but you have to book the visit.

31#12.text: Excellent, I'll keep them in my diary. Now we have to get back, right?

31#13.text: Yes, but cheer up man! Tomorrow we'll see graffiti right behind the university, in Via Schiaffino, then we'll go to a super nice place in Via Bovisasca 57!

32#4.text: It's getting late, we must run to the University, tomorrow I'll take you to the place I care about most. Oh please, let's go through the same door we came out of.
32#4.instruction: Enter the university through the B3 door

33#1.text: This place is special! They organize some event almost every night. We also presented some of our projects here a few times!

33#2.text: Are you serious? I would have really liked to be there... Hey, look! Isn't that Professor Remedia?

33#4.text: But before saying goodbye I want to tell you something: the beauty of the suburbs is that everything hides another meaning. For example, the Spirit bar is number 1 for wines, but even its business card could hide very important letters, it's a good story...

33#5.text: Now I'll show you how people think out here. Let's go to Via Durando 10, in front of the electric car charging column, to see some more street art.

33#7.text: Now I'll show you how people think out here. Let's go to Via Durando 10, in front of the electric car charging column, to see some more street art.

33#40.text: Ok, then I'll have a glass of this red wine, which is what I need right now.

33#31b.text: I don't know... I'd like to keep a clear head 'cause Yda could try to make us slip up at any moment...

33#41b.text: As for me, I’d need someone to intercede for us with the headmistress about the Yda situation...

33#21a.text: You're right! I really need something to help me stop thinking about it...

34#4.text: Yes, I'm very fond of it indeed. Now let's go to Via Imbriani 54, there are two really beautiful murals; the second is called "Il Guardiano", write it down please, Guido always wants me to remember it, his favorite artist made it.

35#4.text: Yeah, now look... By the way, the guide always repeated something in dialect, I liked it so much that I wrote it everywhere, but as usual I can't remember it...

35#7.text: Sirio, fuck! You made a hole right on the word!

35#8.text: Eh, bro, I'm sorry... But look at the plaque below the school's! Let's try to move the sheet over the letters to see if something meaningful comes out.

35#10.text: You'll see, bro, I'm a genius, a genius

35#14.text: Crazy, eh? By the way, I just remembered there’s a super cool place in Via Butti 18, come on, come on!

36#12.text: I didn't think you'd ever done anything healthy in your life hahaha.

36#13.text: I am a man of many resources, yo. Anyway you have to get my milkshake, it's so good man, I guarantee it.

36#17.text: Easy, the owner surely still has the recipe hanging somewhere, he left it there to keep me from forgetting it every time hahaha.

36#21.text: All very good bro, trust 5-year-old Sirio, write it in the diary, you’ll thank me. So, what word do the first letters make?

36#28.text: Ah yeah, what a fool, it's the name of the square just around the corner. When we get there remind me that we have to play PING PONG, it's tradition.

37#1.text: Here they are, the idiots who run away like dogs without a leash. I've had enough of you two breaking the balance guaranteed by the rules. I will report everything to the principal.

37#2.text: Oh Yda, what a surprise... You just can't stay away from us, huh? You should understand that I discovered more things being out of here for just a few hours than in all the years I spent in there.

37#4.text: Oops, I'm really forced to take you to Principal Moretti, what a pity. Let's go to B2.2.14, now!

37#5.text: Sure, do as you wish, idiots, I'm not going to waste any more time with you. Go and live in the middle of Chaos. Two fewer problems for the university's order.

37#8.text: Shit, that's wonderful, I was in that place less than a month and I was already thinking about suicide, I don't know how you managed all those years hahaha.

37#9.text: Well, you saw how dumb I was until a few days ago hahaha Thanks to you I'm finally learning how to be myself! Gimme five bro!

36#26.title: Sirio's milkshake
36#26.text: The milkshake recipe Sirio invented at five. He listed the ingredients in an order that means something.

unclear.text: …useful to you! keeek / I appreciate keek / hang out in keek suburbs
unclear.note: 'keek'/'keeek' (Guido's tic?) is not an English word; left as is. If it stands for 'chic' or a laugh, spell it consistently.

unclear.text: We were waiting for you... we saw you last night as well. Unfortunately Yda caught us…
unclear.note: Spoken by Yda, but it is Petronio's line to Roberto from 4#7 (copy-paste leftover); reachable (16: 6→7→11; 29: 6→7). Grammar fixed, but the line needs rewriting or a different speaker.

unclear.text: Good evening professor! We saw you climb over the University gate, twice...
unclear.note: Petronio says his line to Roberto (4#399b) to Su after choosing 'Awesome' (offer to learn bijouterie). Leftover from scene 4.

unclear.text: Ahaha they're cool! They're a crew of guys… let's go to the park in Via Candiani…
unclear.note: Petronio describes Sirio's old crew and sends them to Via Candiani right after Sirio said 'let's go to Via Livigno 5' (looks copied from 8-1). Speaker and destination contradict the scene.

unclear.text: Who knows why nothing surprises me anymore ahahah Yet to be 100%. Sirio you have to tell me what you don't remember!
unclear.note: 'Yet to be 100%' has no clear meaning (maybe 'Just to be 100% sure'?).

unclear.text: Bomb, then let's get something to drink, like a small glass of red wine.
unclear.note: Speaker is Su, but 'Bomb' is Roberto's catchphrase and Roberto answers the follow-up (33#40); probably Roberto's line.

unclear.text: Now let's go to Via Imbriani 54, there are two really beautiful murals; the second is called "Il Guardiano"
unclear.note: flow.json puts 2501's 'Il Guardiano' in Via Carnevali 113, while Via Imbriani 54 is Reka's mural; check the address.

unclear.text: That ban notice with your face on it hahaha.
unclear.note: Original 'That ban with your face on' — guessed it is a 'keep out' notice with Sirio's face (clue 27#11 calls it a KEEP OUT flyer).

unclear.text: Hey, Sirio, come here… there’s that shadow again!…
unclear.note: The original text also contained '\nSirio: I’m bloody curious… this time we really have to avoid Yda!', duplicated by the next beat (2-1-3#10, spoken by Sirio): removed from Petronio's line.

unclear.text: The Suburb? How did you ever get there?
unclear.note: 'The Suburb' (singular, capitalised) kept as a possible in-world name; elsewhere it's 'the suburbs'.
